question: Which sector of the economy focuses on intellectual activities and innovation?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Quaternary Sector**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Intellectual activities refer to mental processes that involve critical thinking, problem-solving, and creativity.
 
• Innovation is the process of introducing new ideas, methods, or products.
 
• Together, intellectual activities and innovation drive progress and development in various fields.
 
• From an exam point of view, understanding the concept of intellectual activities and innovation is crucial.
 
• You may be asked to define these terms, explain their importance, or discuss real-world examples of intellectual activities leading to innovation.
